records.title: A Site Post-Plant Nanoswarm from A Long
records.description: From the A Long position shown in the source clip, line up and throw a Nanoswarm onto the A Site plant for a post-plant denial. Reproduce the exact crosshair reference and release shown in the original clip. Be ready for defenders to swing from A Main, as the creator notes.

source.author: AirtightRiver41
source.evidence: Tracker identifies the material as Killjoy Haven attack, titled 'Post-plant line up for A', and the creator warns about defenders swinging from Main. The embedded clip was visually reviewed: the minimap and A Long start position are visible, followed by a Nanoswarm throw toward the A Site plant area. The feed entry keeps the exact aiming reference in the creator's original clip; source reviewed, not tested in a live match. Haven is in the current Competitive map pool, and Riot's 13.08 notes list Corrode as the map with geometry updates.
source.rightsBasis: The short creator guide is linked and embedded from the original Tracker page. No image, thumbnail, screenshot or video file was copied or rehosted.
